items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: I think his name was Jack Rich if I remember, I’m not positive.

ctx.x: So we were scooping these things up, me with my employee discount you know. And I’m wondering as you did the business to be able to re-issue those, were you working with Alton Abraham and Sun Ra or just Sun Ra? I notice they all say Infinity on them, which is their company that goes back to the 50s, right?

Yeah. And the Infinity was just a name. I don’t want to get sued for this, I don’t think I can, it was just a name I believe. Their business dealings were in the cosmos so it was not incorporated to my knowledge and here’s a story I never told before. Here’s an exclusive. Very good questioning, Christian. I wanted to do the deal with Sun Ra to license his recordings. And he had asked a promoter, the guy who did Sun Ra’s gigs here in the United States, I think his name was Jack Rich if I remember, I’m not…
